title: Classic Margarita
description: Fresh lime, a little orange, and a simple syrup you make yourself so you can dial the sweetness to the fruit. Shaken, served over ice.
notes: Mocktail: replace the tequila and orange liqueur with 6 oz lime sparkling water and a squeeze of lemon.

steps.text: In a small saucepan, stir the sugar and water together over medium-high heat. Bring to a low boil, reduce to medium-low, and simmer until the syrup is slightly thickened. Let it cool and store it sealed in the fridge until you need it.
steps.tip: Makes more than this recipe uses; it keeps for a month.

steps.text: Pour the lime juice, orange juice, simple syrup to taste, tequila, and orange liqueur into a shaker with ice. Shake until the outside frosts, then divide between two 12 oz glasses over fresh ice.
steps.tip: Sweeten last — how much syrup it takes depends entirely on the limes.
